title: zazzle-csharp-indexer MCP tools component diagram
description: The tools grouped by where their answers come from: the index, git, an external regex engine, an allowed command or the syntax tree of one C# file.

components.name: Index-backed tools
components.responsibility: overview, outline, find_symbol, find_references, find_files, changed_since, search and read: answers from file records, blob facts and the files on disk.

components.name: External regex fallback (ExternalSearch.cs)
components.responsibility: Runs rg -P, or git grep -P when rg is missing, for patterns .NET rejects, and reshapes the output like search.

components.name: Git tools (GitTools.cs)
components.responsibility: git_log and git_blame with compact formats.

components.name: Command passthrough (RunTool.cs, RunPolicy.cs)
components.responsibility: Runs an allowed read-only program with an argument list in a root, with a timeout and an output budget.

components.name: Terse view tool (ViewTool.cs)
components.responsibility: view: reads one .cs file in a root and returns its terse view under a header with the line count and the changes per step.

components.name: Gap report (ReportGapTool.cs)
components.responsibility: Puts the agent's one-sentence note into the usage log.

components.name: Shared helpers (ITool.cs, RootSet.cs, Output.cs, Glob.cs)
components.responsibility: The tool contract and argument helpers, root:path references, globs and token-budgeted output.

components.name: Content analysis
components.responsibility: Bloom filters, literal extraction and the stored symbol format.

components.name: Terse C# view
components.responsibility: Builds and formats the view from the file text.

components.name: git command-line tool
components.responsibility: log, blame, grep -P, and the passthrough's read-only subcommands.

components.name: ripgrep (rg), if installed
components.responsibility: PCRE2 search for the regex fallback.

relationships.description: Files, Freshen, Barrier, Sync, ChangesSince, Gen and WaitReady.
